Version 2.15.2 (8th June 2024)

= Improved Frequently Bought Together UX
- Catalogue image will not be used as backup image for inventory. This is to improve performance.
- Item counters from search and product list filters to improve speed
- Breadcrumb on product detail page.
* Product permission issue when the catalog system is off
* Get item API issue fixed
* Message HTML tag issue fixed
* Checkout warning for missing information improved.
* Fixed issue where add to cart icon appeared for auction items instead of place bid icon.
* Fixed user profile view modal issue on admin panel
* Fixed order details and contact seller button not working in disputes tab in customer dashboard.
* Fixed delete icon breaking when avatar is uploaded in customer dashboard my account tab
* SKU view issue on inventory lists
* Guest cart page issue when the packaging is not available
* Guest checkout issue

Version 2.15.1 (28th April 2024)

+ Now vendors can add attribute values to any attribute
